title: Irish Wrap Delight
description: A hearty and flavorful wrap filled with springy Irish meat, kissed with spices.
instructions: Season the Irish meat with salt, pepper, and kissed spices.
Wrap the springy wrap in a damp paper towel and microwave for 20-30 seconds.
Place the Irish meat in the center of the wrap.
Top the meat with goat cheese.
Fold the bottom half of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap into a snug cylinder.
Place the wrap seam-side down on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Dot the top of the wrap with butter.
Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the wrap is crispy.
